scope: DNA core/federation/runtime module migrations and saved SQL model ownership
verificationMethod: Full regression followed by targeted corrections and verification. Effective results use the latest result for each test suite; the entire 728-case regression was not repeated after test-only corrections.

postgres.version: PostgreSQL 17.11 (Debian 17.11-1.pgdg13+2) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit

environment.credentialHandling: Random disposable credentials passed through environment only; values excluded.

correctionHistory: The first full regression completed with two old H2 expectations that failed operations leave no receipt. Existing implementation, design and real database tests require a durable rejection. Corrected these tests to verify rejection replay and zero parent/detail/snapshot rows with one rejection receipt; new corrected commands use a new operation key.
The corrected aggregate suite ran 5 cases successfully; the 28-case composition suite also reran successfully with an additional real PostgreSQL permission-array read assertion.
After correcting a test-method abbreviation style violation, the final command passed all five scoped style reports, module boundaries and the 5-case aggregate suite.
verifiedScenarios: Dependency-ordered installation of three manifests owning 22 PostgreSQL control tables
All 22 domain entities validate and query in shared storage and with runtime on a separate store; mandatory core/federation co-storage remains intact
Federation JDBC permission sets round-trip through PostgreSQL array mapping
Restart preserves model data, applies zero migrations and retains independent module histories
Runtime baseline matches existing six SQL migration scripts for columns, constraints and indexes; legacy scripts replay in a second schema without same-name constraint interference
Receipt tenant ownership/result completeness, active model versions and resource generation/tenant constraints reject invalid data
Real maintenance-control fixture installs versioned modules then validates mappings while PostgreSQL/MySQL target publication, maintenance, offline and recovery scenarios run
Saved SQL model catalogue tests pass after entity relocation; old host class is absent from build output
limitations: Only five logical domain modules currently have SQL manifests; incomplete platform coverage still prevents full installation.
PostgreSQL is the only declared DNA control schema dialect; MySQL tests target runtime-managed business storage, not a MySQL control schema.
The complete suite mixes unit/H2 tests and gated real database tests. No claim that all 728 cases use real PostgreSQL or MySQL.
Runtime-managed business/child tables and target infrastructure journals remain under existing runtime protocols, not fixed control schema migrations.

Formal host startup still uses its existing path. Remaining domain schemas, shared event/Flowable contributions, legacy adoption, installation ordering, HTTP extraction, standalone and full topology acceptance remain unfinished.
No business environment deployment, existing business database mutation, frontend distribution build, commit or push.
